projectDescription: A full-stack web application for managing burger restaurant orders, kitchen workflow, inventory, and daily sales reporting.
keyFeatures: Digital menu with 26 items across Hamburgers, Breakfasts, and Drinks categories
Real-time shopping cart with quantity management
Order placement with customer info, delivery type, and payment method
Live order tracking with progress bar (30% → 60% → 100%)
Kitchen dashboard showing active orders as printable tickets
Inventory toggle per item (available/out-of-stock) synced via MongoDB
Real-time stock sync every 10 seconds on the customer-facing menu
Daily sales report with total revenue and completed order details
Support for pickup (Sucursal) and home delivery (Domicilio)
Payment via cash (Efectivo) or bank transfer (Tarjeta)
publicApiSurface: GET /cocina — Kitchen dashboard with active orders and inventory control
GET /estado/<pedido_id> — Check order status (preparando / listo / no_encontrado)
GET /api/stock — Get current inventory availability as JSON
POST /toggle_disponibilidad — Toggle item availability in inventory
POST /marcar_listo — Mark an order as completed and move to sales history
